data.sub: Bombay HC ne BMC ko fatkar lagai ki VIP ke liye sadkein kyu chamkayi gayi.

chat.say: Pehle koi Prince ko bulao yaar!

data.asar: VIP aane par hi sadak saaf hogi, aam janta dhool fanke.
data.caption:
British Prince Mumbai aaye toh BMC ne sadkein ekdum chamka di, fir kya tha High Court ka para chadh gaya!

🚷 Bombay HC ne BMC ko lagai fatkar
🚷 Sawaal: VIP ke liye hi sadak kyu?

Apne us dost ko tag karo jo har baar safai par bhashan deta hai!
